source_analysis.skill: Evaluate exact cosine values using the cosine sum and difference formulas.

Apply the identity with the correct product sign.

permitted_variations: Vary component angles, quadrants, formula sign, target angle and angular units coherently.
Allow positive, negative, radical, rational and cancellation outcomes.
Use source-supported radio and exact-entry responses.
